issue.author: regehr
issue.body:
both the AArch64 and x86-64 backends assert out on this input:
```
define i32 @f(i1 %0) {
  %new0 = srem i1 %0, true
  %last = zext i1 %new0 to i32
  %2 = icmp ne i32 %last, 0
  %3 = select i1 %2, i32 0, i32 1
  ret i32 %3
}
```

comments.author: RKSimon
comments.body: They appear to be failing in llvm::TargetLowering::prepareSREMEqFold   https://clang.godbolt.org/z/Pjf8bnrnE

comments.author: resistor
comments.body: Almost certainly the assertion just needs to be moved above the special case.
